hero.title: Fish at our core, with agriculture, livestock and investment alongside
hero.intro: AZAFCO International works in fish, agriculture, livestock and investment. Fish is our core business: we farm, source, pack and export fresh fish to 7+ markets in the Middle East and beyond.
hero.reassure: Start with a message: species, quantity and destination. Prices confirmed per order.

allocation.title: How our businesses fit together
allocation.intro: One parent brand. Fish leads, and our other activities sit alongside it.
allocation.core_text: We farm and source fish, then pack and export it fresh: 12 main species, a packing capacity of up to 2,500 t/month and 7+ markets.
allocation.agri_text: Farmland with fruit and vegetable production.
allocation.invest_text: Part of our corporate portfolio. This website focuses on our fish business.

seafood.title: Fish, from the pond to the pallet
seafood.p1: We farm and source fish, then wash, ice, grade, inspect and pack it at our plant in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh. From there, our own refrigerated trucks, cold stores and logistics take it to air or road freight.
seafood.p2: We supply 12 main species, and other species on request, whole and fresh chilled. We hold three ISO certificates (ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018), certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.
seafood.image_alt: Whole fresh fish on crushed ice in white insulated boxes in a packing hall
